omitted_tabs.reason: XTDB 2.1.0 has users only: no roles or role membership
XTDB 2.1.0 has no GRANT; the server's authentication rules decide access

gaps.reason: No DROP USER in XTDB 2.1.0, and pg_catalog.pg_user refuses writes ("Cannot write to table: pg_catalog/pg_user", live 2026-10-31): every user is permanent
Shown read-only: only the built-in xtdb user is a superuser, and no statement changes it

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Letters, digits, _ and $, starting with a letter or _. A user cannot be deleted or renamed afterwards.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: Changing it on an existing user runs ALTER USER. Whether XTDB asks for it depends on the server's authentication rules: the default rule trusts every connection (Authenticator.kt DEFAULT_RULES), so the password is stored but not checked.

notes: Hand-written for providers/xtdb/client.py. The post-state check reads pg_catalog.pg_user: a new user must be listed, and a password change must change the stored hash (compared by digest; the hash is never returned).
